From Crazy Diamond · Fix what is broken, but never yourself.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: 1 action: stand repairs an object it touches (as a success on Repair, no tools). Surge, 2 actions: heal a creature @Damage[(2+floor((@actor.level - 1)/2))d8+@actor.system.abilities.cha.mod[healing]]{2d8 + your Charisma modifier, +1d8 at every odd level}. Can't target you or your stand.
  • 5: Reassemble: when your stand restores a broken object, it can fuse a creature into it (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} on a failure, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{restrained} on a critical failure, 1 round).
  • 9: Healing also ends one of persistent damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained 1}.
  • 13: Surge heals two creatures.
  • 17: Once per day, restore a creature that died since your last turn to 1 HP, if its body is intact and your stand can touch it.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
